overview.text: In 2026, laws he backed regulating consumer fees and expanding opportunities for people with records became law. A criminal justice reform bill he sponsored was signed in 2025. He sponsored gun control and collegiate athlete compensation legislation, and helped negotiate the state's clean energy package. He co-sponsored a bill requiring companies to disclose algorithmic pricing and let consumers opt out. He chiefly sponsored a megaprojects bill to convince the Chicago Bears to build an Arlington Heights stadium. He is a top House budget negotiator.
